earnings.title: Fortive Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Delivered Q3 GAAP diluted EPS of $0.57, up 63% year-over-year, and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.77, up 13% year-over-year
Revenue of $1.11 billion, up 7.8% year-over-year; core revenue up 7.2%
GAAP diluted EPS of $0.57, up 62.9% year-over-year; adjusted diluted EPS of $0.77, up 13.2% year-over-year
Q3 revenue growth accelerated to 7.8% year-over-year on a reported basis and 7.2% on a core basis
Completed ~$300 million of share repurchases in Q3, bringing total share repurchases since the launch of new Fortive to ~$2.3 billion, representing ~43 million shares or ~13% of shares outstanding

quotes.text: Q3 was another quarter of strong and accelerating performance for Fortive. We delivered over 7% core growth, approximately 10% adjusted EBITDA growth, and 13% adjusted EPS growth, representing our fifth consecutive quarter of double-digit adjusted EPS growth.

outlook: Raising our FY 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $3.10 to $3.14, up ~15% year-over-year at the midpoint
For FY 2026, Fortive now expects adjusted diluted earnings per share of $3.10 to $3.14.
